title: Apoorva Sangama
desc: Brothers Raj and Shankar choose opposing paths after goons murder their father. Raj turns outlaw seeking vengeance, Shankar joins the police force.

title: Kaamannana Makkalu
desc: With the help of his two sons, Kaamanna, a former thief, decides to start a new life on the right side of the law.

title: Tagaru Palya
desc: After a villager secures a marriage alliance with a city boy for his only daughter, he prepares to offer a sacrifice to the gods. However, things go awry during the ceremony.

title: Leader
desc: Vijay is a rebellious law student who boldly criticises the government, flirts with a beautiful woman and invites trouble. But his life changes when he is accused of assassinating a politician.

title: Chandra Chakori
desc: Puttaraju and Sevanthi fall in love with each other. Sevanthi's father puts forth a condition for their marriage which Puttaraju must fulfil.
